---
title: "Conventions"
status: open
---

> Example: the conventions file of the KOSMA-tau PDR project (photon-dominated regions,
> astrochemistry). It shows the kind of definitions that belong in a project's conventions.

## Units

All physical quantities in cgs unless stated otherwise. Temperatures in K.

## Densities and abundances

- $n$ or $n_\mathrm{H} = n(\mathrm{H}) + 2\,n(\mathrm{H_2})$: total density of hydrogen nuclei in cm$^{-3}$.
- Abundances $X_i = n_i / n_\mathrm{H}$.

## Radiation field

- $\chi$: FUV field strength in units of the **Draine** field (not Habing, $G_0 \approx 1.71\,\chi$). Every deviation must be stated explicitly in the entry.

## Extinction

- $A_V$ measured from the illuminated surface; conversion $N_\mathrm{H}/A_V$ according to the model parameter, state it in the entry.

## Rate coefficients

- Two-body rates $k$ in cm$^{3}$\,s$^{-1}$, photo-rates in s$^{-1}$; source/version of the network in the provenance.

## Labels and IDs

- Entries: `YYYY-MM-DD_slug`; runs `R-NNNN`; events `E-NNNN`.
- Quarto labels with slug prefix: `fig-<slug>-<name>`, `eq-<slug>-<name>`, `tbl-<slug>-<name>`.
